# Drive calibration (generated by `junkyard_calibrate drive`)

The Drive stage (`src/dsp/DriveStage.h`) is run on five deterministic synthetic materials (8 s, stereo, 48 kHz) scaled to each
input loudness L (-36..0 LUFS, ITU-R BS.1770-4 K-weighted, ungated) and each drive d (0..30 dB). The makeup is
`m = L_in - L_out`, after discarding the first 100 ms. `T[d][L]` is the mean of `m` over the materials; `D[d]` is the minimax
default row over L in [-26, -6] LUFS. `kDefaultL` = -14 LUFS (the integer L in [-26, -6] with the smallest worst-case |m - D|; worst case there 2.26357 dB).

## Corpus

| material | loudness (LUFS) | crest (dB) |
|---|---|---|
| pink | 7.6 | 12.8 |
| drums | -10.2 | 16.1 |
| bass | -9.6 | 9.9 |
| full mix | 4.7 | 15.5 |
| mastered mix | -8.0 | 9.2 |

## Default curve and its honest error

`resid` is the worst case |m - D| over L in [-26, -6] and all five materials. `spread@-16` is max-min of `m` across the
materials at -16 LUFS. `err@default` is the worst |m - D| over the five materials at `kDefaultL`. Every row is clamped to +-24 dB; d = 0 is exactly 0.
